description: Proactive Messages (the Proactive Messages page in the dashboard, Pro and Enterprise): the chatbot writes FIRST when something happens on the website. Each rule says WHEN (a click on an element, a page address, time on the page, or an event the website's own code sends, such as added_to_cart), WHAT (a fixed text with optional translations, or an instruction the AI writes the message from) and HOW (a bubble above the chat button, or the chat opens). Use this for anything like a triggered message, an automatic message, a message on click, on a page or after some seconds. Returns every rule with its id and its counts for the last 30 days (shown, opened, replied).

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.
